audience: course creators and training teams that build and publish online courses in Coursebox

useCases.title: Read the outline of a course
useCases.text: Read the sections of a course in order, with the lessons of each section, to find their ids.

useCases.title: Build a course outline
useCases.text: Create a draft course, then add its sections in order and an empty lesson in each section.

useCases.title: Write a lesson with AI
useCases.text: Send one lesson and a plain-language instruction to Coursebox's AI. Put exact text and quiz questions in the instruction, and read the reply in case the AI asks a question.

useCases.title: Rename sections and move lessons
useCases.text: Rename a section, or move a lesson to a new position inside its section.

useCases.title: Publish or pull back a course
useCases.text: Publish a draft course for public or private joining, or return a published course to draft. Edits after publishing go live at once.
